heading: The creative side
disclaimer: Recreated samples. The original client work is confidential.
subheading: Performance marketing isn't just bidding and keywords — it's creative that arrests the scroll. 12 sample assets designed for high-CTR conversion across 6 industries.

items.title: HVAC Emergency Hook
items.hook: “AC stopped at 2 AM in July? Here's who actually picks up.”
items.description: Fast-paced pain-point reel showing immediate response guarantee and verified technician dispatch within 45 mins.

items.title: Transparent Pricing Breakdown
items.hook: No surprise invoices. Fixed diagnostic fee.
items.description: High-contrast carousel slide comparing hidden contractor fees vs transparent flat rates.

items.title: Same-Day Orthopedic Booking
items.hook: “Knee pain keeping you off the field this weekend?”
items.description: Direct patient-centric motion graphic leading directly into one-click WhatsApp appointment scheduler.

items.title: Doctor Credibility Spotlight
items.description: Clean, trustworthy aesthetic highlighting surgeon credentials and authentic patient outcome statistics.

items.title: Exhaust Note Soundwave Hook
items.hook: Turn up your volume. That’s what precision tuning sounds like.
items.description: High-adrenaline short video syncing dyno-run audio with staged performance upgrade milestones.

items.title: Track Day Spec Comparison
items.description: Data-dense visual graphic built for gearheads who prioritize real telemetry and dyno sheets over fluff.

items.title: Walkthrough with Actual Price
items.hook: “No ‘DM for price’. Here’s exactly what ₹1.2 Cr buys in OMR.”
items.description: Busts real estate cliches by disclosing genuine pricing upfront, eliminating unqualified leads instantly.

items.title: Rental Yield & ROI Snapshot
items.description: Targeted at NRI & IT investors comparing commercial vs residential rental returns with amortization graph.

items.title: Macro Sparkle & Hallmark Verification
items.hook: Look for the laser-etched BIS Hallmark. Here’s how.
items.description: Macro close-up video establishing authenticity, hallmark purity, and heritage craftsmanship.

items.title: Modern Minimal Daily Wear
items.hook: Fine 18K gold engineered for desk-to-dinner elegance.
items.description: Lifestyle product aesthetic pairing light gold jewellery with contemporary office workwear.

items.title: One Shirt, 3 Workday Outfits
items.hook: Client meeting, deep work, dinner drinks.
items.description: Snappy transition reel demonstrating versatility of wrinkle-free cotton linen apparel for men.

items.title: Fabric Longevity & Fit Guarantee
items.hook: Zero shrink guarantee. Free exchange in 48 hours.
items.description: Removes the #1 objection in online apparel purchasing (fit risk and fabric quality after first wash).
